meta.measurementMethod: playwright-core (chromium headless, 1440x900) getComputedStyle on documentElement vars and key elements; theme set to dark/light with proper inline tunable values applied to isolate CSS token state
meta.notes: settings.js applies 5 tunable color tokens as inline styles on <html>; measurements below reflect CSS token definitions plus correct per-theme inline values. bundle.css (react/bundle.css) is loaded after css/style.css and was found to override --border globally.
